title: Adapting Sleep Foundation Models for Dense Sleep Spindle Localization
abstract: arXiv:2611.06546v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting sleep foundation models to dense electroencephalography (EEG) event localization is challenging because multi-second representations may not preserve sufficient temporal detail for precise boundary recovery. We address sleep spindle localization by adapting a frozen SleepFM encoder with a local time-frequency pathway that preserves spindle-relevant spectral content and intra-token position. The local representation drives localization, while residual cross-attention incorporates SleepFM temporal context. Dense predictions are obtained through localized token-to-sample reconstruction and temporal refinement. Tested on the Massive Online Data Annotation (MODA), the proposed model achieves an event-level $F_1$ of $0.8080 \pm 0.0040$ at IoU 0.2 across six folds. Ablations show that localization primarily depends on local spectral and sub-token temporal information, while the pretrained representation provides complementary context

translated_title: 将睡眠基础模型适配于密集睡眠纺锤波定位
translated_abstract: 将睡眠基础模型适配于密集脑电图（EEG）事件定位具有挑战性，因为多秒级表示可能无法保留足够的时序细节以实现精确的边界恢复。我们通过适配一个冻结的SleepFM编码器并引入局部时频通路来解决睡眠纺锤波定位问题，该通路保留了与纺锤波相关的频谱内容和令牌内部位置信息。局部表示驱动定位任务，而残差交叉注意力则融合SleepFM的时序上下文。密集预测通过局部化的令牌到样本重建和时间细化获得。在海量在线数据标注（MODA）数据集上的测试表明，所提出的模型在六折交叉验证中，IoU为0.2时达到了0.8080 ± 0.0040的事件级F1分数。消融实验显示，定位主要依赖于局部频谱和子令牌时序信息，而预训练表示则提供了补充性上下文。
tldr: 该论文提出通过为冻结的SleepFM编码器添加局部时频通路与残差交叉注意力机制，成功实现密集睡眠纺锤波定位，在MODA数据集上取得了0.808的事件级F1分数。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts a frozen SleepFM encoder with a local time-frequency pathway and residual cross-attention for dense sleep spindle localization, achieving an event-level F1 of 0.808 on the MODA dataset.
